edition.locus: Baehrens GCS 30 Iesu Nave Hom. I 6

source_text: Repromittit Iesus: Omnis locus quemcumque subdideritis vestigiis pedum vestrorum vester erit. Nobis adversariarum potestatum gentes diabolicae. Quantascumque subdiderimus, ipsorum regiones Iesu distribuente capiemus. Lucifer cecidit; si eum vincere potuero et Dominus conterat Satanan sub pedibus meis, locum Luciferi accipere merebor. Ira, superbia, zelus, avaritia, libido angelos incentores habent; nisi vitia in temet ipso viceris et de terra baptismi exterminaveris, plenitudinem hereditatis non accipies.

Anger, pride, envy, greed, lust angels goading have; unless vices in yourself you-shall-have-conquered and from land of-baptism you-shall-have-exterminated, fullness of-inheritance not you-will-receive.
pass_b_english: See what Jesus promises his soldiers: [[Every place you set the soles of your feet shall be yours >> Bible:Joshua 1:3]]. To them it meant Canaanite regions; to us it means diabolic nations of opposing powers against which we sweat in this life’s contests. However many of those nations we subdue underfoot, we receive their provinces as Jesus distributes them. They were once angels in God’s kingdom — [[How you have fallen, Lucifer, who rose in the morning! >> Bible:Isaiah 14:12]]. If I can conquer him and the Lord [[crushes Satan under my feet >> Bible:Romans 16:20]], I may deserve Lucifer’s place in heaven. Anger, pride, envy, greed, lust each have goading angels; unless you defeat those vices in yourself and drive them from the land already sanctified by baptism’s grace, you will in no way receive the fullness of the promised inheritance.
